page.notes: The running head's title is in heavy type and I could not read it. The faint mark at the lower left is a stain, not transcribed. The quotation marks at the start of each line are printed and are kept. The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The ligature "fenfionis" and the spellings "ufus", "poenas", "ꝑ" are as printed. "firmamentū" is printed with a macron over u.
